# inkmap

> Per-pixel foreground coverage for photographed marks -- QR, barcodes, text, any shape you can model


## Pages

- [inkmap](index.html.md): Per-pixel foreground coverage for photographed marks.
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;inkmap&#96;   | inkmap -- per-pixel foreground coverage for photographed marks.   |
- [inkmap](_autosummary/inkmap.html.md): inkmap – per-pixel foreground coverage for photographed marks.
- [inkmap.locate](_autosummary/inkmap.locate.html.md): Locators: finding where a model sits in an image.
- [inkmap.locate.barcode](_autosummary/inkmap.locate.barcode.html.md): Locating linear (1-D) barcodes.
- [inkmap.locate.marks](_autosummary/inkmap.locate.marks.html.md): Find square registration marks: solid squares and nested squares, sub-pixel.
- [inkmap.locate.patch](_autosummary/inkmap.locate.patch.html.md): Locate a plain printed patch – a uniform colour rectangle – and the substrate round it.
- [inkmap.locate.qr](_autosummary/inkmap.locate.qr.html.md): Locating QR symbols: a cascade of interchangeable strategies.
- [inkmap.models](_autosummary/inkmap.models.html.md): Shape models: what the foreground is expected to look like.
- [inkmap.models.base](_autosummary/inkmap.models.base.html.md): What a &#42;model&#42; is, and how it becomes pixels.
- [inkmap.models.freeform](_autosummary/inkmap.models.freeform.html.md): Models for shapes that are not on a grid: rasters, polygons, and text.
- [inkmap.models.grid](_autosummary/inkmap.models.grid.html.md): Models whose foreground is defined on a regular grid: QR symbols and barcodes.
- [inkmap.geometry](_autosummary/inkmap.geometry.html.md): Model space &lt;-&gt; image space: transforms, and refining them against the photograph.
- [inkmap.photometry](_autosummary/inkmap.photometry.html.md): Turning masks into measurements that are actually valid.
- [inkmap.config](_autosummary/inkmap.config.html.md): Tunable defaults, in one place.
- [inkmap.corpus](_autosummary/inkmap.corpus.html.md): The real-photograph test corpus: 384 photographed marks in the wild, from Wikimedia Commons.
- [inkmap.coverage](_autosummary/inkmap.coverage.html.md): Per-pixel foreground coverage: the 0..1 value, and which one you want.
- [inkmap.synth](_autosummary/inkmap.synth.html.md): Synthetic scenes with exact ground truth.
- [inkmap.types](_autosummary/inkmap.types.html.md): The data types the whole package speaks in.
- [inkmap.viz](_autosummary/inkmap.viz.html.md): Visual overlays, for checking that a result is actually right.
